titre: Le trafic de données mobiles en Allemagne
sous_titre: Volume annuel transmis sur les réseaux mobiles allemands, en milliards de gigaoctets, 2023 à 2025

2023.texte: the volume of data transmitted through mobile networks in Germany in 2024 amounted to 9,592mn GB, compared to 9,118mn GB in 2023

2024.texte: The volume of data transmitted through mobile networks in Germany in 2025 amounted to 10.9bn GB (2024: 9.6bn).

2025.texte: The volume of data transmitted through mobile networks in Germany in 2025 amounted to 10.9bn GB (2024: 9.6bn).
